exportVerification.exportTool: macOS CoreGraphics/ImageIO through Python ctypes; high-quality resize; white composite; native JPEG encoder defaults

conformance.reviewNote: Visually reviewed both PNG and JPG. Five separate routes align left; two similarly weighted custody outcomes align right. Wide corridor allows unambiguous editable branching. All devices, signs and tokens blank; conceptual keys show control, not secrets. All required strings, qualifications, and relationships are preserved in the incorporated source brief and any attached guide text. Reference can be rebuilt as editable HTML/CSS/inline SVG.
